definition: Per target/season/location: total native-unit model WIS / total ensemble WIS on identical tasks, all eligible dates and horizons 0-3. States/DC ratios average equally with 80% weight; US ratio gets 20%. Absent geography groups renormalize over available groups. Within season: weighted mean of available targets, admissions 1 and ED .5. Combined: equal mean of seasons. Configurations: mean and SD across seeds. Nonpositive ensemble denominators raise an error; missing run support is not silently dropped.
